description: Command to the core on `bunny.cmd.art-show.hub` (Hub #1581): show one saved artwork now on the named surfaces, each a configured display's routing ID or `browser`. The core runs the scheduled appearance's plan path with a near-term start and independently tracked operations per surface; it starts no generation and changes no mode. `coversStatus` defaults to true. The reply and the outcome use the profile's reply and outcome payloads; the outcome is never an aggregate display success.
